reasoning: Multiple credible sources from early 2026 consistently report Apple is developing a foldable iPhone (iPhone Fold) with a projected launch in September 2026 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series. Reports cite specific details: book-style design, 5.3-5.5 inch outer display, 7.7-7.8 inch inner display, titanium frame, Touch ID, and $1,800-$2,500 pricing. The device reportedly entered NPI phase at Foxconn in March 2025 with mass production expected October 2026. However, some sources note possible delays to 2027 if components need refinement. Given the consistent reporting from multiple analysts and the advanced development stage, but acknowledging Apple's history of delays and that no official announcement has been made, I estimate a moderately high probability.
